instruction.name: rotri.w
instruction.description: Rotate the low 32-bit word right by an immediate.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.init: addi.d $r12, $r0, -1; addi.d $r13, $r0, 2; addi.d $r14, $r0, 3; addi.d $r15, $r0, 4; addi.d $r16, $r0, 5; addi.d $r17, $r0, 6; addi.d $r18, $r0, 7; addi.d $r19, $r0, 8; addi.d $r23, $r0, 9; addi.d $r24, $r0, 10; addi.d $r25, $r0, 11; addi.d $r26, $r0, 12; addi.d $r27, $r0, 13; addi.d $r28, $r0, 14; addi.d $r29, $r0, 15; addi.d $r4, $r0, 16
experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 50 --unroll2 200 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r12, $r0, -1; addi.d $r13, $r0, 2; addi.d $r14, $r0, 3; addi.d $r15, $r0, 4; addi.d $r16, $r0, 5; addi.d $r17, $r0, 6; addi.d $r18, $r0, 7; addi.d $r19, $r0, 8; addi.d $r23, $r0, 9; addi.d $r24, $r0, 10; addi.d $r25, $r0, 11; addi.d $r26, $r0, 12; addi.d $r27, $r0, 13; addi.d $r28, $r0, 14; addi.d $r29, $r0, 15; addi.d $r4, $r0, 16' --asm 'rotri.w $r12, $r12, 1'

latencies.notes: Latency from rj to rd for a 32/64-bit rotate: one cycle, the same as any wide ALU operation. The repeated copy closes the chain.

throughput.notes: Eight independent lanes with disjoint registers take 2.00 cycles, twelve take 3.00 and sixteen take 4.00, so the wide rotate sustains 4 instructions per cycle.

notes: 64-bit and 32-bit LBT-style rotate: one cycle from either source and a sustained 4 IPC, the same as a plain wide ALU operation. Only the byte and half-word forms cost two cycles.
